metadata.name: 11.1.c Area of strolling-recreational parks and green areas per capita in the city
metadata.priority: Enhancement of cities and urbanised areas' capability for sustainable development and workplace creation as well as improvement of quality of life of their inhabitants by taking into account the need to increase green areas, water areas and ventilation corridors in urban development plans
metadata.definition: Parks and small urban green spaces per capita.
metadata.methodology: Parks are green areas of at least 2 hectares, comprising high and low vegetation, developed and maintained for public recreational use and equipped with visitor infrastructure such as paths, benches, and playgrounds. They include internal water bodies and publicly accessible areas for water-based recreation, sports, and games.Small urban green spaces are publicly accessible green areas under 2 hectares with a dominant recreational function, including green areas associated with public buildings and monuments, boulevards, promenades, and publicly accessible recreational sports and water-related areas. They may consist of lawns, flowerbeds, trees, and shrubs forming landscaped urban green compositions.
